messages:
maria: Quick reminder — 0.6.3 release cutoff is today at 18:00 UTC. Please avoid merging to main after cutoff unless you have an approved post-cutoff hotpatch.

maria: TL;DR for post-cutoff hotpatch requests — attach a short risk note, tag the PR, and get explicit sign-off from the release lead + oncall. I'll paste the mini-process below.

maria: ```To request post-cutoff merge:
1) Add label `post-cutoff-hotpatch` to the PR
2) Add a 1-paragraph risk justification and which tests were impacted
3) Get explicit approval from @lee (release lead) and @sam (oncall) in the PR thread
4) Ensure CI on the release branch is green and a smoke deploy was run locally or on staging
```

sam: Quick Q — docs-only changelog tweak: do we need full approvals?

lee: For docs-only (changelog, README) we don't need release lead approval, but please add `docs-only` label and get one reviewer. No post-cutoff exception needed for pure docs edits.

anika: Is the version bump allowed after cutoff if it's just the build metadata (no code)?

lee: Version metadata-only changes should be kept to the release branch. If you absolutely must change main post-cutoff, follow the hotpatch process. Better: open a PR to the release branch and tag me, I can merge during the grace window.

maria: We're allowing a short grace window after 18:00 UTC for critical hotpatches — up to 30 minutes. Outside that we escalate to emergency follow-the-rollout process.

sam: Who's on for approvals during the window? I can cover 18:00–18:45 UTC.

lee: I'll be available 17:30–19:30 UTC to triage. If both me + oncall sign off, maintainers can merge.

release-bot: @channel release-candidate branch created: `rc/0.6.3` — CI started (link: https://ci.internal/repo/0.6.3).

devops-bot: Deploy checklist triggered for `rc/0.6.3` — smoke tests queued.

anika: If a backport is needed to 0.6.x branch, do we follow same signoff?

lee: Yes — backports need the same approvals. Also include the target branch in the PR title: `[backport to 0.6.x]` so release tooling picks it up.

sam: Small request — can we add a short changelog nudge to the PR template for this release? I keep seeing missing entries.

maria: Good call. I'll push a tiny PR to the template now so CI won't block but reviewers will see the reminder.

lee: One more operational note: label `post-cutoff-hotpatch` will auto-bump priority in the release dashboard. If you add it, ping me in the PR.

maria: I'll post a quick reminder in #general at 17:45 with the cutoff and the link to the release checklist. Thanks all — please escalate here if anything unexpected crops up. :rocket:
